description: Per-repository source, license, pin, Rust target, parity contract, and enhancement record for Elementary image/customization projects and required build inputs.

update_policy.pin_change_gate: Review the project diff, confirm its license at the pinned revision, run the project's parity/build gate, and record image/hardware qualification before changing the active pin.

license.evidence: GitHub repository license declaration; retain and verify the license file at the selected source revision.

pin.meaning: OS 9 source-audit comparison point, not a claim that this is the current upstream head.

projects.rust_target: A Rust project for every executable image-build, installer, and update component, with generated declarative mkosi inputs where the upstream interface requires them; full build-contract parity is required.
intentional_enhancements: M-series Apple Silicon image and sysupdate profile, tracked separately from elementary's baseline behavior.
projects.qualification: The source audit baseline is pinned; the full Rust build-system replacement and image parity are not complete.

pin.meaning: Pinned package-seed source snapshot for mapping the configured desktop image; the image currently consumes PPA-built metapackages rather than building this source checkout.

projects.rust_target: A separate Rust package-selection and metapackage generator preserving Elementary seed semantics, Debian package relationships, and amd64/arm64 outputs.
parity_contract: same package membership for minimal, standard, desktop, and Pantheon profiles
same architecture-specific package relationships and recommends
reproducible Debian metapackage outputs and dependency closure
projects.qualification: Pinned seed files identify 58 repository candidates represented in the ARM64 desktop inputs plus the OS build source; source-package mappings, actual resolved package closure, and Rust generator parity remain to be verified. The partial native generator in mseries/rust/seed-compiler now passes 56 synthetic map/list file comparisons with Germinate 2.49 across four configurations and eight substvars comparisons (Linux run 40236407482). The metadata-only archive builder additionally passes 40 synthetic dpkg/Debhelper package comparisons in Linux run 40238235136, alongside 29 crate tests. Unchanged pinned Elementary source rules additionally pass 32 real-source package comparisons (Linux run 40238779709), with 32 native package hashes matching local macOS builds. Lexical variable expansion from the real live seed is now implemented; Linux run 40239533941 passes 36 synthetic profile membership and extended 56 map/list comparisons plus all package checks, with the retained native package hashes unchanged. This qualifies checked-in map/list-to-package assembly and tested substitution semantics. Linux run 40240688243 additionally passes all 33 real seed/archive map/list files with signed captured inputs and actual debootstrap sets; exact input/output fingerprints are retained. Production native acquisition/bootstrap, package installability and full-project/image/runtime parity remain unqualified.

projects.rust_target: Keep this upstream seed repository as a separately pinned data input read by the Rust package generator at build time; do not vendor seed text into the local Rust project, and review licensing before redistributing generated or source data.
